using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Tsavorite.core;

namespace Tsavorite.Tests
{
    public class IndexRecoveryTests : TsavoriteBase
    {
        private readonly Mock<ILogger<TsavoriteBase>> _loggerMock;
        private readonly Mock<IDevice> _deviceMock;

        public IndexRecoveryTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TsavoriteBase>>();
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(It.IsAny<LogLevel>())).Returns(true);
            logger = _loggerMock.Object;

            _deviceMock = new Mock<IDevice>();
            _deviceMock.Setup(d => d.SectorSize).Returns(512u);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AsyncPageReadCallback_LogsError_WhenErrorCodeIsNonZero()
        {
            // Arrange
            uint errorCode = 123;
            recoveryCountdown = new CountdownWrapper(1, isAsync: true);

            // Act
            AsyncPageReadCallback(errorCode, 1024, null);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.LogError(
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("AsyncPageReadCallback error:") && v.ToString()!.Contains(errorCode.ToString())),
                    It.IsAny<object[]>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
            Assert.True(recoveryCountdown.IsCompleted);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AsyncPageReadCallback_DoesNotLogError_WhenErrorCodeIsZero()
        {
            // Arrange
            recoveryCountdown = new CountdownWrapper(1, isAsync: true);

            // Act
            AsyncPageReadCallback(errorCode: 0, numBytes: 1024, overlap: null);

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogError(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
            Assert.True(recoveryCountdown.IsCompleted);
        }
    }
}

namespace Tsavorite.Tests

        private readonly TsavoriteBase _tsavorite;

        public IndexRecoveryTests()
        {
            _loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<TsavoriteBase>>();
            _loggerMock.Setup(l => l.IsEnabled(It.IsAny<LogLevel>())).Returns(true);

            _tsavorite = new Mock<TsavoriteBase> { CallBase = true }.Object;
            _tsavorite.logger = _loggerMock.Object;
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AsyncPageReadCallback_LogsError_WhenErrorCodeIsNonZero()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockCountdown = new Mock<CountdownWrapper>(1, isAsync: true) { CallBase = true }.Object;
            _tsavorite.GetType().GetField("recoveryCountdown", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
                     .SetValue(_tsavorite, mockCountdown);

            uint errorCode = 123;

            // Act
            _tsavorite.GetType().GetMethod("AsyncPageReadCallback", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
                     .Invoke(_tsavorite, new object[] { errorCode, 1024u, null })!;

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString()!.Contains("AsyncPageReadCallback error:") && v.ToString()!.Contains("123")),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
                ),
                Times.Once
            );
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AsyncPageReadCallback_DoesNotLogError_WhenErrorCodeIsZero()
        {
            // Arrange
            var mockCountdown = new Mock<CountdownWrapper>(1, isAsync: true) { CallBase = true }.Object;
            _tsavorite.GetType().GetField("recoveryCountdown", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
                     .SetValue(_tsavorite, mockCountdown);

            // Act
            _tsavorite.GetType().GetMethod("AsyncPageReadCallback", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance)!
                     .Invoke(_tsavorite, new object[] { 0u, 1024u, null })!;

            // Assert
            _loggerMock.Verify(
                l => l.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.IsAny<It.IsAnyType>(),
                    It.IsAny<Exception>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception?, string>>()
                ),
                Times.Never
            );
        }
    }
}
